summary: The file test checks whether a path is an existing regular file on the controller.
questions: How do I check if a local file exists on the control node in a condition?
Does the file test look at the remote host?

answer_card.title: file test (controller paths)
answer_card.answer_md: `path is file` is true if the path is an existing file on the **controller** (localhost). Use `stat` for files on managed hosts.
